name: Explainer Video Smoke Test (The Dropbox Prototype)
phase: Low-Fidelity Prototyping and Smoke Testing Tactics
hypothesis: We believe our proposed workflow interface is intuitive enough to drive mass consumer adoption. We will verify this by posting a 2-minute demonstration video showing simulated software interactions to target developer channels, and consider it validated if the waitlist grows by ≥ 10,000 qualified signups within 48 hours.
schematic: Read at step 3 of the 3-step strip

plan.label: Preparation
plan.text: Cut a two-minute video of the core workflows, showing the frustration it removes.

plan.label: Execution
plan.text: Seed it in niche developer communities and link to an early-access waitlist.

plan.label: Data collection
plan.text: Track retention drop-off, views, landing conversion and the tone of discussion.

planFull.label: Preparation
planFull.text: Create a short video walking through core product workflows, deliberately highlighting how the product solves acute, relatable user frustrations.

planFull.label: Execution
planFull.text: Seed the video across relevant niche communities, developer boards, and technical networks. Link directly to an early access waitlist landing page.

planFull.label: Data collection
planFull.text: Track video retention drop-off rates, aggregate view counts, landing page conversion percentages, and community discussion tone.

warning.label: Entertainment and Novelty Virality
warning.text: A clever video earns shares, not paying users, once the novelty wears off.

warningFull: A slick, entertaining, or clever demonstration video can generate significant viral buzz and social shares that fail to translate into active, paying users once the novelty wears off.
